exampleSentence: 技術は著しく進歩しました。
naturalUsageNotes: More formal than すごい and often describes a clearly measurable change.

exampleSentence: 結果を踏まえて計画を直します。
exampleTranslation: We will revise the plan based on the results.
notes: Common in business and formal language.
dictionaryMeaning: to step on; to tread on
naturalMeaning: to take into account; to base a decision on
naturalUsageNotes: In modern formal usage, ～を踏まえて means ‘taking … into account.’ Do not translate it as physically stepping on something in this pattern.
